howToPlay: Utilize bushes whenever possible to stay hidden and recover health with the Plant Life star power. Deploy the Grow Light gadget to create cover or use the Unfriendly Bushes gadget to damage and slow hidden opponents.
gears: Equip the Speed, Health, and Damage gears to increase mobility and survivability. Use the Shield or Gadget Cooldown gears to boost endurance and utility during matches.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy aggressive tank gameplay and tactical map control using environmental cover.
